notes: Set ocr.language to eng, urd, or eng+urd only when the matching Tesseract language data is installed.
Provide only compatible, licensed model files.
Labels must be in the exact order used during model training.
The PKR classifier estimates denomination and side only; it does not authenticate banknotes.
Do not treat model scores as guaranteed accuracy.
YOLOv8 ONNX support accepts standard single-output Detect exports with 4 box values plus one score per class; other YOLO tasks/output layouts are rejected.
Whisper ASR requires a complete local model and processor directory; install the asr-whisper extra. No model download occurs at inference time.
